nh-county-officials.summary: The County card names the county you picked, and not its commissioners or other elected officers. The card says so rather than leave the offices looking empty.
nh-county-officials.why: No statewide list of New Hampshire's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
nh-county-officials.wanted: One statewide list of each county's commissioners, sheriff, county attorney, treasurer, register of deeds and register of probate, or a county's own published list of them.

nh-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City or Town card names the city or town you picked, and not its select board, council or mayor.
nh-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of New Hampshire's cities and towns has been read for this app, and their own pages have not been read one by one.
nh-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each city's mayor and council and each town's select board, or a city's or town's own published list of them.

nh-school-board-members.summary: The three School District cards name the districts you picked, and not the members of their school boards.
nh-school-board-members.why: No list of the school board members of New Hampshire's school districts has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
nh-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.
